sentences: For `image_get_resinfo` on a 2D array, X/Y are the width/height at the requested mip, Z is the view layer count and W is its mip count.
The query reads the sampled array at binding 3.
A native gfx1036 kernel returned (19,11,5,3), (9,5,5,3) and (4,2,5,3) for the three mips of a synthetic array.
On RTX 5080 and Radeon Graphics the translated query matched those tuples and returned (4,2,3,2) at relative mip 1 with a view starting at mip 1 and covering three layers.
The registered `ps_array_resinfo` draw checks all 4096 pixels against (8,8,12,1).
